For 10 Pro users billed annually, the cost is **$2,400 per year**.

Pro is $24/user/month, and annual billing gives you 2 months free, so each user pays for 10 months: $240/user/year × 10 users = $2,400. Paying monthly would cost $2,880, so annual saves you $480.

For a custom quote or discounts, contact billing@lumen.io.
